title: Platform engineering standup  2026-03-24
content:
Date: 2026-03-24
Attendees: Priya, Ethan, Maya, Luis, Anika (via Slack)

Summary:
Quick standup focusing on control plane migration progress, routing policy rollout, auth token rotation, and quota enforcement changes. Spent most of the meeting triaging a control-plane cache invalidation regression that caused intermittent quota miscounts for a subset of customers during the 03/23 canary.

Control plane (Priya / Ethan)
- Progress: canary migration to new config-store-backed control plane is 65% complete. New store (kvstore-v2) deployed to eu-west and us-west canaries.
- Issues: observed cache-invalidation regression (INF-2378) where stale routing config persists for ~45s after a push, causing requests to be routed to older model variants and quota counters to be double-counted in some flows. Reproduction steps added to JIRA.
- Actions: Ethan to push a hotfix to config-cache TTL handling (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/298) and run a controlled canary deploy tomorrow morning 03/25 09:00 PT. Priya to coordinate with SRE for feature-flag rollback plan.
- Notes: Need a post-mortem if hotfix doesn't fully address root cause. Add a synthetic test that simulates rapid sequential config updates (notes to self).

Routing (Maya)
- Progress: smart-routing policy v1 (latency-aware + cost tiering) passed integration tests. Load tests show 6-8% p50 latency improvement for mixed short/long sequences.
- Canary: routing v1 is in 10% of traffic for internal canaries. Two observed issues: (a) fallback logic triggers too early for small models under high qps, (b) metrics tagging missing for fallback events. Filed INF-2402.
- Actions: Maya to add additional debug labels for fallback events and extend the cooldown window for fallback decisions from 20s -> 60s. Test plan scheduled for 03/25.

Auth & Service Accounts (Luis)
- Progress: service-account rotation automation is 80% complete. Integration tests with KMS key rotation passing in staging.
- Incident: a small set of 3rd-party internal services saw 401s yesterday due to token expiry not being refreshed under high concurrency. Root cause: race in token-refresh lock acquisition.
- Actions: Luis to merge lock fix and increase token-lease buffer from 30s -> 90s. Also add telemetry to surface token-refresh latency spikes. Target deploy 03/24 EOD to staging, promote to prod after smoke tests.

Quotas & Rate Limiting (Anika via Slack)
- Progress: new incremental quota counters (per-route + per-customer) implemented; running against replay tests.
- Problem: because of control-plane cache issue, some quota counters were double-incremented during the 03/23 canary. This inflated usage reporting and caused erroneous soft-limits for ~5 customers.
- Actions: Anika to run reconciliation job that backfills counters for affected customers and reconcile billing signals with billing team. Also add a compensating transaction in quota writes to make counters idempotent.

Operational items / On-call
- SRE: will run an extended canary on 03/25 after Ethan's hotfix. On-call rotation: Luis hands off to Maya on 03/26.
- Monitoring: add a dashboard widget showing config push -> effective config latency and a fallback-rate heatmap by region. Priya to file dashboard ticket.

Open questions / decisions needed
- Do we shorten canary ramp if the cache-fix is pushed? Decision: keep ramp conservative (10% -> 25% -> 50%) but shorten wait windows if no errors after 30m at each step.
- Quotas idempotency: should be a short-term fix in code or an intermediary DB migration? Prefer code-level compensating writes first.

Action items (owners)
- Ethan: hotfix cache TTL handling + merge PR (target: 03/25 09:00 PT). (JIRA: INF-2378)
- Priya: coordinate SRE for canary rollback plan and create monitoring dashboard ticket. (confluence: PLATFORM-CONTROL-PLAN)
- Maya: add fallback event labels, extend cooldown window, run routing canary tests (target: 03/25). (JIRA: INF-2402)
- Luis: merge token-refresh lock fix, increase lease buffer, deploy to staging (target: 03/24 EOD).
- Anika: run quota reconciliation for affected customers and implement idempotent counter writes.

Notes to self / informal
- Follow up with billing on noisy usage alerts from 03/23 canary  might need a temporary credits grant for affected customers.
- Draft a short customer-facing blurb if reconciliation impacts billing visibility. Priya to draft.
- Remember to update the rollout runbook with the new config-cache TTL rollback steps.

Next meeting / cadence
- Regular platform standup daily at 10:00 PT. Extended post-mortem review scheduled 03/26 11:00 PT if needed.

End of notes.
